quote.text: That element of tragedy which lies in the very fact of frequency, has not yet wrought itself into the coarse emotion of mankind.
quote.author: George Eliot, Middlemarch (1871–72), Chapter XX

stories.headline: The ministry called it a limited fire
stories.dek: Three people with direct knowledge told Reuters the blaze ran between the sixth and tenth floors. Another said the ceiling came down in the chief executive’s office.

stories.kicker: Singapore · The Rung That Never Came
stories.headline: The masks went out below the published threshold
stories.dek: The response ladder starts at a 24-hour reading of 200. The index peaked at 168, and the Government triggered on a different instrument instead.

stories.headline: The hotel licenses the name. A Las Vegas firm fills it
stories.dek: Thread count was settled as a deception in 2002, and fill power has a tolerance wider than the grades it sells. What is actually inside, and what it costs.

stories.headline: The jury found a breach and priced it at two dollars
stories.dek: Both companies declared victory on the same verdict. The clause actually worth billions was never put to the jury at all.

stories.headline: Singapore is the one market that cannot buy it
stories.dek: Meta sells three other pairs here, priced. On the Singapore page this one reads “Not available”, twice. The camera is gone; nine-tenths of the price is not.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · The Limited Edition
stories.headline: Five thousand watches, each engraved limited edition
stories.dek: Seiko’s panda chronograph has a Singapore price, which is rarer than the watch. Add Citizen’s, and seven days produced 10,200 limited Japanese watches.

stories.headline: The chart’s own publisher forecast a Beatles number one
stories.dek: Four days before the data existed, Official Charts called it. The album held the top for eight weeks in 1965 and finished second to a Stockport band’s debut.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · Twelve Thousand Steps
stories.headline: The dividend is a tenth of a standard deviation
stories.dek: The best age-matched study of the year finds walking helps a twelve-year-old’s mental health, consistently and by dose. It also finds nothing at all for school results.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Hot Print
stories.headline: The market priced a hike, then priced its consequences
stories.dek: September inflation came in hot at half past eight, and more than half of it was petrol. By the close every yield from three years out had fallen.

stories.headline: The first computer was a loom, and it still ships
stories.dek: A weaver is someone who has automated the lifting. The machine Babbage copied is in production in Norway this morning, from €38,000.

stories.kicker: Fitness · Half A Million Treadmill Tests
stories.headline: The biggest fitness study ever run adds two points
stories.dek: 562,234 people, ten years of follow-up, and the number everyone will quote. What it actually improves is discrimination, from 0.662 to 0.682.

stories.headline: Thirteen of sixteen publish no price at all
stories.dek: The arts-council festivals print their prices. The promoters and the sports bodies have moved theirs behind a button. One deadline falls this Sunday.

stories.headline: The secret ballot survives. The secret abstention does not
stories.dek: A law in force this month wires whether you voted into the pension file. The payment is about twenty-seven dollars, which is not the point.
